correctness.rationale: The exact graph is the 24-root D4 polytope graph with vertices +/-e_i+/-e_j and Euclidean inner-product-one adjacency (96 edges, degree eight). By the definition of Lovasz open-neighborhood complex, every face is a nonempty subset of one of its 24 neighbor sets; independent reconstruction deduplicates the complete 5088 faces, with f-vector (24,264,960,1608,1344,672,192,24). Applying the explicit ordered 24-pivot elementary pairing to every available face yields 2519 disjoint pairs, leaving exactly one critical 0-cell, one critical 1-cell, 48 critical 3-cells. Independent complete traversal of all 22128 Hasse cover incidences after reversing matched arrows topologically sorts all 5088 faces, proving the matching acyclic (not merely a greedy cancellation log). The resulting Forman CW complex has one 0-cell, one 1-cell and 48 3-cells, with no 2-cells. All maps S2 -> S1 are null because pi_2(S1)=0, so the *integral homotopy type*, not just F2 Betti numbers, is S1 wedge 48 S3. The separate mod-2 boundary ranks 23,240,720,840,504,168,24 provide consistency only. Exact finite one-graph certification is exhaustive.
residual_risks: Formal proof in general case remains mathematical argument; finite checks do not constitute formal certification.
